cards.definition: A very difficult job (अत्यंत कठिन कार्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Rewriting the parser was an arduous task.

cards.definition: The act of making something greater (वृद्धि / संवर्धन)
cards.exampleSentence: Data augmentation improved the model.

cards.definition: Kind and generous (परोपकारी)
cards.exampleSentence: A benevolent manager gave the team flexibility.

cards.definition: A harsh mixture of loud sounds (कर्कश शोर)
cards.exampleSentence: A cacophony of alerts overwhelmed the on-call engineer.

cards.definition: Something that causes change or action (उत्प्रेरक)
cards.exampleSentence: The outage was a catalyst for reform.

cards.definition: Annoyance from failure or embarrassment (खिन्नता)
cards.exampleSentence: To his chagrin, the bug was his own.

cards.definition: To come together to form a whole (एक में घुल-मिल जाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Ideas coalesced into a clear plan.

cards.definition: Making a certain result likely (अनुकूल)
cards.exampleSentence: A quiet space is conducive to deep work.

cards.definition: A confusing and difficult problem (उलझन भरी पहेली)
cards.exampleSentence: The schema change posed a conundrum.

cards.definition: Unnecessarily complicated reasoning (उलझा हुआ तर्क)
cards.exampleSentence: The convoluted logic made debugging painful.

cards.definition: Too ready to believe things (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भरोसा करने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Don't be credulous about vendor claims.

cards.definition: A division into two contrasting parts (दो विपरीत भागों में बँटवारा)
cards.exampleSentence: There's a dichotomy between speed and quality.

cards.definition: A situation requiring a hard choice (दुविधा)
cards.exampleSentence: We faced a dilemma over delaying the release.

cards.definition: Disagreement between people (मतभेद)
cards.exampleSentence: Discord within the team slowed progress.

cards.definition: Drawing from a wide range of sources (विविध स्रोतों से लिया गया)
cards.exampleSentence: The team has an eclectic mix of skills.

cards.definition: The ability to produce a desired result (प्रभावशीलता)
cards.exampleSentence: We tested the efficacy of the new alerts.

cards.definition: A short-lived quality (क्षणभंगुर स्वभाव)
cards.exampleSentence: The ephemeral nature of containers requires external storage.

cards.definition: Calmness in difficult situations (समभाव / शांति)
cards.exampleSentence: She handled criticism with equanimity.

cards.definition: Demanding great care and effort (अत्यंत कठोर मानकों वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: The client's exacting standards raised quality.

cards.definition: Showy and attracting attention (दिखावटी और आकर्षक)
cards.exampleSentence: He gave a flamboyant presentation.
